newsitem.title: FRANCE: Natexis cuts Skis Rossignol rating.
newsitem.headline: Natexis cuts Skis Rossignol rating.

text.p: Brokerage Natexis cut its rating on Skis Rossignol stock to underperform from outperform, citing disappointment with its April-June sales, portfolio managers said on Thursday.

Natexis said the ski firm's 11.82 percent sales drop for the first quarter of its 1997/98 year underscored a gloomy outlook expressed by the firm which is striving to balance sales of its summer and winter sports equipment.
The broker cut its earnings per share forecast to 5.7 francs from 7.7 for Skis Rossignol for this year and to 6.8 francs from 9.2 for 1998/99.
Broker Ferri remains a seller on the stock. It said Skis Rossignol's geographic sales mix was inferior to that of its rival Salomon and recommended arbitrage in Salomon's favour.
Shares in Skis Rossignol were up 1.58 perent at 122.40 francs at 1245 GMT. Shares in Salomon were 1.46 percent higher at 487.
